name: Selunara
source:
Selunara struggles with bright light and even brighter people. She trusts easily, and follows with unwavering loyalty. Soft-spoken and sensitive, she’s still learning how to feel safe in a world much larger than her.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4014730/Harem_of_Ankhutep/]Steam[/url]]
